annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a casual restaurant and fitness conversation about meals and bowl ingredients at Chipotle. The free-food discussion concerns a restaurant buy-one-get-one promotion and food provided after staff requested help with a stuck salt shaker, rather than a financial or data-related offer. No request for payment, credentials, investment participation, or other consequential audience action is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content centers on general lifestyle conversation about restaurant food and powerlifting, including a brief account of receiving food at the restaurant.
